names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 14 august, «Sfântul Proroc Miheia», with the rank word left off.
Read out of saint.gr's line for 14 Αυγούστου, «Προφήτης Μιχαίας», with the rank word left off. The page glosses it as a Hebrew word, the one like God.

death.note: As printed by days.pravoslavie.ru: “Прор. Михея (из 12-ти пророков) (VIII до Р.Х.)”.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 14 августа ст. ст. — «Прор. Михея (из 12-ти пророков) (VIII до Р.Х.)»
Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 14 august — «Sfântul Proroc Miheia»

attestations.note: The Romanian page for this day is careful that there were two prophets of the name, and says which one the day's service is for: «erau doi proroci cu numele de Miheia: cel dintâi, care a prorocit lui Ahab... iar altul, care a trăit mulți ani după cel dintâi, a fost acela care a prorocit despre nașterea lui Iisus Hristos în Betleem și a scris carte de prorocie. Deci, de vreme ce în Minei s-a pus slujba celui de-al doilea, iar în Prolog sinaxarul este scris despre cel dintâi...» The Menaion service on 14 august is therefore for the second, the writing prophet of the Twelve, who is this folder's man and the Russian and Serbian rows' man; the narrative the page prints beside it is the first, Micaiah son of Imlah, the contemporary of Elijah, who is not this folder and has no folder. Read 24 September 2026.

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 14ης Αυγούστου — «Προφήτης Μιχαίας»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 14 Αυγούστου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The Russian, Romanian and Serbian rows already keep him on this menologion day, and the Greek entry is the same minor prophet: «ο προφήτης Μιχαίας έζησε στην Ιερουσαλήμ το 748 - 696 π.Χ., επί των βασιλέων Ιωάθαμ, Άχαζ και Εζεκίου», of the tribe of Judah, born at Morasthi and so called the Morasthite, nearly contemporary with Isaiah, sixth of the minor prophets, his prophecy in seven chapters. The folder's 8th-century-BC date stands; the page's 748–696 is an interval for his life in Jerusalem and not a birth or a death, so no `dates` is proposed from it. **The page then gives him the death of the other prophet of the name: it says he was a severe critic of the lawlessness of Ahab, king of Judah, was hunted by him into the mountains, and under Ahab's son Joram was arrested and hanged, his kinsmen burying his body at Morasthi near the burial ground of Enakeim. The folder's Romanian source is careful that there were two prophets called Micah and says which one the day's service is for; saint.gr is not, and its account is recorded as the page's own in the life rather than adopted. Named in the reader's report.** No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page. It prints one hymn, an apolytikion in the fourth tone to the model Ταχὺ προκατάλαβε, which names him; it is added.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), календар за 27.08.2026 (14. август ст. ст.) — „Свети пророк Михеј“

hymns.text: Пророка Твога, Михеја, успомену Господе славимо, зато Те молимо, спаси душе наше.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), тропар за 14. август ст. ст. — „Свети пророк Михеј“

english.text: We glorify, O Lord, the memory of thy prophet Micah; and therefore we entreat thee: save our souls.

hymns.text: A prorocului Tău Miheia pomenire, Doamne, prăznuind, printr-însul Te rugăm, mântuieşte sufletele noastre.

source.text: doxologia.ro, «Troparul Sfântului Proroc Miheia», Glasul 2 — the common troparion of a prophet, printed here with his name in it

english.text: Keeping the memorial of your prophet Micah, O Lord, through him we entreat you: save our souls.

hymns.text: Ὡς ὀρὸς περίοπτον, καὶ ἐμφανὲς ἀληθῶς, προεῖδες ἐν Πνεύματι, τὴν Ἐκκλησίαν Χριστοῦ, Μιχαία θεόπνευστε, ὅθεν οἱ εὐρηκότες, ἐν αὕτῃ σωτηρίαν, βαίνουσιν ὡς προέφης, ἐν ταὶς τρίβοις Κυρίου, γεραίροντες προφῆτα, τὴν πάνσεπτον μνήμην σου.

source.text: saint.gr, Ἀπολυτίκιον (Κατέβασμα), Ἦχος δ’, Ταχὺ προκατάλαβε — the only hymn on the page of «Προφήτης Μιχαίας», and it addresses him by name, «Μιχαία θεόπνευστε», as the prophet who foresaw the Church

english.text: As a mountain conspicuous and truly manifest, you foresaw in the Spirit the Church of Christ, God-inspired Micah; wherefore those who have found salvation in her walk, as you foretold, in the paths of the Lord, honouring, O prophet, your all-venerable memory.
